column1: # shortcuts.tsv -- JFDiagrammer's default shortcuts per UI language (FEATURES.md 3.16, LG-08, F10)
# A row: the command (the constant's name in src/commands.rs), then its keys in de, en, es,
# it, fr.  Keys: English names joined by '+' (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, A..Z, 0..9, F1..F24, PgUp,
# PgDn, Del, Ins, Home, End, Enter, Left, Right, Up, Down); several chords of one command
# with '|'; an empty cell: no shortcut in that language.  Each language follows the Office
# convention of that language for the text formats and the file commands (bold: de
# Ctrl+Shift+F, en Ctrl+B, es Ctrl+N, it/fr Ctrl+G); the Visio keys fill the rest where they
# do not collide.  Own shortcuts go into the settings ([keys] NAME=Ctrl+Shift+F) and replace a
# row's cell (prepared for UI-19).  check_lang.py reports two commands on one chord.
# Where the Office conventions take a Visio key, the command moves (decisions F10, LG-08):
#   de   Fett/Kursiv/Unterstrichen on Ctrl+Shift+F/K/U, so In den Vordergrund / Hintergrund
#        go to Ctrl+Shift+PgUp / PgDn and Gruppierung aufheben to Ctrl+Shift+G
#   es   Guardar Ctrl+G, Buscar Ctrl+B, Reemplazar Ctrl+L, Nuevo Ctrl+U, Abrir Ctrl+A,
#        Seleccionar todo Ctrl+E, Cursiva Ctrl+K: Agrupar goes to Ctrl+Shift+G, Girar a la izquierda to
#        Alt+Shift+Left (and right to Alt+Shift+Right), Hipervínculo to Ctrl+Alt+K
#   it   Grassetto Ctrl+G, Sottolineato Ctrl+S: Salva goes to Shift+F12, Raggruppa to
#   fr   Gras Ctrl+G: Grouper goes to Ctrl+Shift+G
# Flip horizontal moves from Visio's Ctrl+H to Ctrl+Shift+H in every language (Ctrl+H is
# Replace in Office; KB-02).  The es / it / fr cells for the file commands are Office's as far
# as known here and are still to be checked against an Office of that language.
